alfalfa.legume: Alfalfa is a legume that fixes nitrogen all year.
alfalfa.livingRoots: A crop is growing in 12 of 12 months (0 bare).
alfalfa.residue: Crop residue rated by crop (cereal straw high, cotton stalks and alfalfa roots medium); bare months count as low cover.
alfalfa.lowTillage: About 2 tillage passes a year in the UA 2025 Pinal budgets (6 passes to establish alfalfa, spread over a 3-year stand).

cotton_barley.legume: No legume in this rotation, so no nitrogen is fixed.
cotton_barley.livingRoots: A crop is growing in 11 of 12 months (1 bare).
cotton_barley.residue: Crop residue rated by crop (cereal straw high, cotton stalks and alfalfa roots medium); bare months count as low cover.
cotton_barley.lowTillage: About 10.5 tillage passes a year in the UA 2025 Pinal budgets.
cotton_barley.diversity: 2 crops in the rotation (barley and cotton).

durum_sorghum.diversity: 2 crops in the rotation (durum and sorghum).

fallow.legume: No legume in this rotation, so no nitrogen is fixed.
